name: Investors Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Minimum business investment of ANG 500,000 (approx. US$281,000), which may include property purchases or business ventures.
requirements.fix_path: Make a qualifying business investment of at least ANG 500,000.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires private health insurance coverage and documentation of good behaviour, plus a valid passport.
Minimum business investment of ANG 750,000, which may include property purchases or business ventures.
requirements.fix_path: Make a qualifying business investment of at least ANG 750,000.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires private health insurance coverage and documentation of good behaviour, plus a valid passport.
Minimum business investment of ANG 1,500,000, which may include property purchases or business ventures.
requirements.fix_path: Make a qualifying business investment of at least ANG 1,500,000.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires ongoing private health insurance coverage and documentation of good behaviour, plus a valid passport, even though the permit itself does not require renewal.

evidence_required.document: Certificate of good conduct and valid passport
Permit fees and charges (amount not specified in the source reviewed)

outcome.duration_length: 3, 5, or indefinite years depending on investment tier (see requirement_groups)

sources.title: Curacao Tourist Board / Government of Curacao Immigration Services -- Investors Permit: tiered investment thresholds (ANG 500,000 / 750,000 / 1,500,000), corresponding permit durations (3 years / 5 years / indefinite), and eligibility

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Curacao's initial build. The source itself states the program is issued by the Government of Curacao through its Immigration Services, referencing 'Guidelines Investors Permit 2014' -- corroborated by the existence of a dedicated 'Investeer' (Investor) page on the official immigrationcur.org portal (not independently fetched for full text in this pass; that fetch attempt returned a 404). Modelled as three OR-groups with outcome_override on duration_length (and renewable for the top tier) rather than one group with a vague range, since the investment amount deterministically maps to a specific, materially different permit length -- consistent with this dataset's established pattern for tiered/graduated investment routes. Fee amounts for the permit itself are referenced ('fees and charges apply') but not quantified in the source. work_rights is 'restricted': the permit is residence-based, not an open local-labour-market work authorisation -- the underlying investment/business activity is presumably permitted, but general employment is not confirmed. switchable_to lists both cw_permanent_residence.json (via the 10-year residence clock) and cw_naturalisation.json (via the Kingdom-wide 5-year IND naturalisation track), since holding this permit is a form of lawful residence that plausibly counts toward both, though neither linkage is explicitly confirmed by a source reviewed in this pass.
